about: Pack s08c (sources/art/s08c; docs/design-language/art-plans/s08c-art-plan.md section 6; build/reports/s08c-art-landing/details.md). Cook lines (wave 7A, ids cook-*): KD1 the kadchi, TP1 the teaspoon, GL1 the chai glasses from above, SK4 the sekelo tray, SK5 the sekelo decoys, and the redo's DS1 v2 (the daal's stirred-in pieces), CP4 v2 (the pan's brewing states) and CP3 v2 cells 1-4 (the pan tipping towards the player). New names only (-s08c): nothing the game used before is overwritten. Then build/tools/art/specs/s08c-cook-post.py: tray-0..3 painted out of tray-4, the marble's top-bottom seam and its x2 upscale, the hob cut from assets/cook/bg/bg-cook-hob-t-v1.png (x2, its rounded mask), the black-tea tip frames, the measures (assets/cook/items-s08c/meta.json). Run: python3 build/tools/art/artcut.py build/tools/art/specs/s08c.cut.json --only <the cook-* ids>.
_wt1: WT1 (the marble tile) is not cut here: artcut keys every grid against the ground it finds on the edges, and a full-bleed texture has none, so its colours blew out (alpha near 0, un-premultiplied); s08c-cook-post.py cuts it from the source (4 px in, both seams cross-faded, x2).

jobs._note: DAAR-02: left the empty kadchi, right the stir frame (full of daal); one window so they swap in place. hole_min 8: the handle's hanging hole.
CHAI-13: cell 2 the scoop (the spoonful flies in), cell 3 the stir in milky chai, cell 1 the stir in water or black tea.
CHAI-08: one set from above replaces the chai-v2 glasses. soft 0.25/2.5: the empty glass is clear (12 made its floor opaque grey, 2.2 left a 30 px haze; this passes artpixels at rim 9.7).
SEK-14, SEK-20: grey steel on grey keys at tolerance 5 with no holes (the steel's grey patches are never ground). tray-0..3: s08c-cook-post.py paints the skewers out from the right.
contract-37: heap, raw, grilled, charred per row, named as v3/sekelo names its pieces (404: v3's chunk canvas).
DAAR-05 (the redo, v2): the eight things stirred into the daal, laid on its turning disc for what went in.

CK-06 (the redo, v2): the brewing states; the code shows only their contents' circle (measured by s08c-cook-post.py) over the s08b pan. No shadow option: it takes the black handle for a shadow. Boxes: a handle's end comes within 3-8 px of the next pan's lip.

CHAI-26 (the redo, v2): cells 1-4 only, the pan tipping towards the player 0/20/40/60 degrees; cells 5-6's syrupy streams are not used (js/shared/pour.js draws the stream). s08c-cook-post.py drops the cast shadow (not the shadow option: it eats the black handle), makes the black-tea copies and measures the near rim.
